mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.campus_id AS campusId, c.name, c.type, c.location, c.description, c.opening_hours AS openingHours, c.status, c.average_score AS averageScore, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM stall s WHERE s.canteen_id = c.id AND s.status = #{status} ) AS stallCount FROM canteen c WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.status = #{status} LIMIT 1
